Important: Player Adds/Transfers/Drops - Deadline

Please be aware that any player add or transfer you would like approved to play in the weekend's game MUST be submitted in the YSSL system prior to Midnight on Thursdays.  Any players entered after that day/time we CANNOT guarantee they will be approved and available to play.  
         It is the club's responsibility to enter these players in a timely manner.

Unless your field has lights, games would need to start early as the sun sets by 6:00 p.m. by mid-October.  Click here for the sunset calendar.
